summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of 100% of Sadot Latam LLC to Dream America Marketing Services, Ltd for $1,000 cash plus a 27.5% profit-sharing on collected receivables. The sale closed June 26, 2026. Assets transferred include a $250,000 bank deposit and various receivables; liabilities are assumed as-is. The board authorized the transaction; no advisor named. The SPA is governed by New York law with AAA arbitration. The company will deconsolidate Sadot Latam. Watch for the financial impact of deconsolidation in Q2 2026 results; no risk-arb spread as consideration is nominal.
